Values to control:

```{r analysis-settings}

n_seeds <- 50

alpha_values <- seq(0.05, 1, by = 0.05)

nfolds_values <- c(5, 10, 20)

# Preserve the original individual-biomarker screening threshold.
individual_p_threshold <- 0.10

# Predictor-level significance threshold.
predictor_p_threshold <- 0.05

min_frequency <- ceiling(0.80 * n_seeds)

# The workbook contains two complete-case events at zero months.
# "exclude": explicitly exclude and log nonpositive follow-up times.
# "stop": stop the analysis until these records are resolved.
zero_time_action <- "exclude"

# Elastic-net lambda selection will be applied in its later section:
# baseline_lambda <- baseline_cvfit$lambda.min
# lambda_min <- cvfit$lambda.min
```

## Data Loading

```{r data-loading}
# Load all required libraries in one chunk for global availability
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(lmtest)
library(ggplot2)


# Load data and process
data1 <- read_excel(
  "C:/Users/75118/Desktop/OPUS data for machine learning/cox regression incident non-vertebral fracture/final datafile for machine learning_phenotype-miRs_cox_miR_ratio_norm.xlsx"
)


# Preserve identifiers separately so they cannot become predictors.
sample_ids <- data1[[1]]

excel_rows <- seq_len(nrow(data1)) + 1L


# Remove the first column, containing SampleID.
data <- data1[, -1, drop = FALSE]


# Preserve the original complete-case approach.
complete_rows <- complete.cases(data)

data <- data[complete_rows, , drop = FALSE]

sample_ids <- sample_ids[complete_rows]

excel_rows <- excel_rows[complete_rows]


# Define column indices AFTER removing SampleID.
columns_omics <- 9

columns_nonomics <- 8

columns_categoric <- 2

columns_response <- 7  # Event: IncidentNonVertFX

columns_time <- 8      # Months to event or censoring

columns_predictors <- 1:6

columns_adjustment <- 1 # UniSp4


# Determine expanded design-matrix indices in the elastic-net section.
columns_predictors_x <- NULL


# Define response, time and mandatory predictor names.
response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]

response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

time_col <- colnames(data)[columns_time]

predictor_cols_base <- colnames(data)[columns_predictors]


# BOTH outcome components must be excluded from predictor matrices.
exclude_columns <- c(
  response_cols,
  time_col,
  "row_id"
)


# Validate event coding.
if (
  !is.numeric(data[[response_col]]) ||
  !all(data[[response_col]] %in% c(0, 1))
) {
  stop("Event status must be numeric: 0 = censored, 1 = event.")
}


# Validate follow-up time.
if (
  !is.numeric(data[[time_col]]) ||
  any(!is.finite(data[[time_col]]))
) {
  stop("Follow-up time must contain finite numeric values.")
}


# Check one record per participant.
if (anyNA(sample_ids) || anyDuplicated(sample_ids)) {
  stop("SampleID must be nonmissing and unique.")
}


# Explicitly handle nonpositive follow-up times.
nonpositive_time <- data[[time_col]] <= 0

excluded_time_records <- data.frame(
  Excel_row = excel_rows[nonpositive_time],
  SampleID = sample_ids[nonpositive_time],
  Event = data[[response_col]][nonpositive_time],
  Time_months = data[[time_col]][nonpositive_time]
)

if (any(nonpositive_time)) {

  write_xlsx(
    excluded_time_records,
    "Cox_Nonpositive_Followup_Records.xlsx"
  )

  if (zero_time_action == "stop") {

    stop(
      "Nonpositive follow-up times found. ",
      "See Cox_Nonpositive_Followup_Records.xlsx."
    )

  } else if (zero_time_action == "exclude") {

    message(
      "Excluding ",
      sum(nonpositive_time),
      " complete-case observations with follow-up <= 0 months. ",
      "Their original values are preserved in the exclusion file."
    )

    data <- data[!nonpositive_time, , drop = FALSE]

    sample_ids <- sample_ids[!nonpositive_time]

    excel_rows <- excel_rows[!nonpositive_time]

  } else {

    stop("zero_time_action must be 'stop' or 'exclude'.")
  }
}


cat("Participants retained:", nrow(data), "\n")

cat(
  "Events:",
  sum(data[[response_col]] == 1),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Censored observations:",
  sum(data[[response_col]] == 0),
  "\n"
)


# Preserve these function names for compatibility with later chunks.
# No class balancing is performed for standard Cox regression.

balance_data <- function(df, response_col) {
  return(df)
}


compute_case_weights <- function(df, response_col) {
  return(rep(1, nrow(df)))
}


use_weights <- FALSE
```

## Adjusting Data

```{r adjusting-data}
# ==================> IDENTIFY ALL-ZERO BIOMARKERS <==================

if (columns_omics > ncol(data)) {
  stop("No candidate biomarker columns are present.")
}

biomarker_indices <- columns_omics:ncol(data)


# Verify that biomarkers are numeric.
numeric_biomarkers <- vapply(
  data[, biomarker_indices, drop = FALSE],
  is.numeric,
  logical(1)
)

if (any(!numeric_biomarkers)) {
  stop(
    "Nonnumeric biomarker columns: ",
    paste(
      names(data)[biomarker_indices[!numeric_biomarkers]],
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


# Preserve the original all-zero filtering procedure.
cols_to_remove <- vapply(
  data[, biomarker_indices, drop = FALSE],

  function(col) {
    all(col == 0)
  },

  logical(1)
)


# ==================> REMOVE ALL-ZERO BIOMARKERS <==================

data <- data[
  ,
  c(
    seq_len(columns_nonomics),
    biomarker_indices[!cols_to_remove]
  ),
  drop = FALSE
]


# ==================> VERIFY REMOVAL <==================

if (ncol(data) < columns_omics) {
  stop("No biomarkers remain after all-zero filtering.")
}

biomarker_data <- data[
  ,
  columns_omics:ncol(data),
  drop = FALSE
]

cols_with_all_zeros <- vapply(
  biomarker_data,
  function(col) all(col == 0),
  logical(1)
)

zero_columns <- colnames(biomarker_data)[cols_with_all_zeros]

if (length(zero_columns) == 0) {
  cat("All zero-only columns have been removed successfully.\n")
} else {
  cat("Columns with all zero values still present:\n")
  print(zero_columns)
}

cat("Final dimensions of data:", dim(data), "\n")
```

## Using a categorical variable as a factor

```{r categorical-variables}
# Convert the specified categorical columns to factors.
data[, columns_categoric] <- lapply(
  data[, columns_categoric, drop = FALSE],
  as.factor
)


# Define factorized columns for later design matrices.
factor_columns <- colnames(data)[columns_categoric]


for (col in factor_columns) {

  if (nlevels(data[[col]]) < 2) {
    stop("Categorical variable has fewer than two levels: ", col)
  }
}


# Treatment contrasts: K levels produce K - 1 contrast columns.
contrasts_list <- lapply(
  setNames(factor_columns, factor_columns),

  function(col) {
    contrasts(
      data[[col]],
      contrasts = TRUE
    )
  }
)
```

## Data Scaling

This preserves the global scaling used in the supplied logistic workflow. Training-only scaling would be a separate methodological change applicable to both workflows.

```{r biomarker-scaling}
# Check for columns that scale() cannot standardize.
biomarker_sd <- vapply(
  data[, columns_omics:ncol(data), drop = FALSE],
  sd,
  numeric(1)
)

invalid_biomarkers <- names(biomarker_sd)[
  !is.finite(biomarker_sd) |
    biomarker_sd <= 0
]

if (length(invalid_biomarkers) > 0) {

  stop(
    "These biomarker columns cannot be standardized: ",
    paste(invalid_biomarkers, collapse = ", "),
    ". Check constant nonzero columns or non-finite values."
  )
}


# Scale the omics data.
scaled_biomarker_data <- scale(
  data[, columns_omics:ncol(data), drop = FALSE]
)


# Update the dataset with the scaled biomarker data.
data[, columns_omics:ncol(data)] <-
  as.data.frame(scaled_biomarker_data)
```

## Individual biomarker Cox regression across 50 shared splits

**C-index baseline:** discrimination of the mandatory-predictor Cox model on the independent test set.

**C-index biomarker:** discrimination of the Cox model containing mandatory predictors plus one biomarker.

**ΔC-index:** biomarker-model C-index minus baseline C-index.

**ANOVA:** nested-model partial-likelihood ratio comparison using identical training observations and the same tie-handling method.

No class balancing is applied. The same 50 splits will be reused for elastic net and de-novo Cox refits.

```{r individual-cox, results='asis', warning=TRUE}
# Load necessary libraries.
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(survival)
library(writexl)
library(rsample)
library(DT)


# Initialize lists to store the results.
results_list <- list()

prediction_storage <- list()

predictor_results <- list()

ph_results <- list()

failed_models <- list()


# Stable row IDs must remain available for subsequent sections.
data$row_id <- seq_len(nrow(data))


dir.create(
  "Individually Selected Predictors",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


##########################################################
################ Helper functions ########################
##########################################################

make_cox_formula <- function(time_col, response_col, predictors) {

  variable_names <- c(
    time_col,
    response_col,
    predictors
  )

  if (any(grepl("`", variable_names, fixed = TRUE))) {
    stop("Remove backtick characters from column names.")
  }

  quote_name <- function(x) {
    paste0("`", x, "`")
  }

  as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(",
      quote_name(time_col),
      ", ",
      quote_name(response_col),
      ") ~ ",
      paste(
        quote_name(predictors),
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )
}


calculate_cindex <- function(times, events, risk_scores) {

  risk_scores <- as.numeric(risk_scores)

  if (
    length(times) != length(risk_scores) ||
    length(events) != length(risk_scores) ||
    any(!is.finite(times)) ||
    any(!is.finite(risk_scores))
  ) {
    stop("Invalid survival outcomes or risk scores.")
  }

  evaluation_data <- data.frame(
    time = times,
    event = events,
    risk = risk_scores
  )

  concordance_result <- survival::concordance(
    Surv(time, event) ~ risk,
    data = evaluation_data,

    # Higher Cox risk scores indicate SHORTER survival.
    reverse = TRUE,

    # Harrell's C-index.
    timewt = "n"
  )

  comparable_pairs <- sum(
    concordance_result$count[
      c(
        "concordant",
        "discordant",
        "tied.x"
      )
    ]
  )

  list(
    Cindex = if (comparable_pairs > 0) {
      unname(concordance_result$concordance)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    SE = if (comparable_pairs > 0) {
      sqrt(unname(concordance_result$var))
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },

    Comparable_pairs = comparable_pairs
  )
}


fit_cox_checked <- function(formula, model_data) {

  fit <- withCallingHandlers(

    survival::coxph(
      formula,
      data = model_data,
      ties = "breslow",
      x = TRUE,
      y = TRUE,
      model = TRUE,
      singular.ok = FALSE,
      na.action = na.fail,
      control = coxph.control(iter.max = 50)
    ),

    warning = function(w) {

      # Do not treat nonconverged/infinite estimates as valid inference.
      if (
        grepl(
          "infinite|converg|singular|overflow",
          conditionMessage(w),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ) {
        stop(conditionMessage(w), call. = FALSE)
      }
    }
  )

  if (
    any(!is.finite(coef(fit))) ||
    any(!is.finite(vcov(fit)))
  ) {
    stop("Non-finite Cox coefficients or covariance matrix.")
  }

  fit
}


calculate_ph_test <- function(fit) {

  tryCatch(
    survival::cox.zph(fit),

    error = function(e) {
      warning(
        "Proportional-hazards test unavailable: ",
        conditionMessage(e),
        call. = FALSE
      )
      NULL
    }
  )
}


safe_mean <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(x)
}


safe_median <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_real_)
  median(x)
}


safe_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  sd(x)
}


safe_quantile <- function(x, probability) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (!length(x)) return(NA_real_)
  unname(quantile(x, probability))
}


escape_html <- function(x) {
  as.character(
    htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
  )
}


##########################################################
############ Generate fixed train/test splits ############
##########################################################

splits <- vector("list", n_seeds)


for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

  set.seed(seed)

  # Stratify by event status, not follow-up time.
  # Treat the 0/1 indicator explicitly as a factor for splitting.
  split_data <- data

  split_data$.split_event <- factor(
    split_data[[response_col]],
    levels = c(0, 1)
  )

  splits[[seed]] <- rsample::initial_split(
    split_data,
    prop = 0.70,
    strata = .split_event
  )
}


# The .split_event helper MUST NOT be used as a predictor.
exclude_columns <- unique(
  c(
    response_cols,
    time_col,
    "row_id",
    ".split_event"
  )
)


saveRDS(
  splits,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Shared_Cox_Train_Test_Splits.rds"
)


##########################################################
################ Begin 50-seed loop #######################
##########################################################

for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")

  split <- splits[[seed]]

  train_raw <- rsample::training(split)

  test_data <- rsample::testing(split)


  # Remove the stratification helper from modeling datasets.
  train_raw$.split_event <- NULL

  test_data$.split_event <- NULL


  if (
    sum(train_raw[[response_col]]) == 0 ||
    sum(test_data[[response_col]]) == 0
  ) {
    stop("A training or test split has no events.")
  }


  predictors <- setdiff(
    predictor_cols_base,
    c(response_col, time_col)
  )


  baseline_formula <- make_cox_formula(
    time_col,
    response_col,
    predictors
  )


  # Preserve existing names, but do not balance the Cox training data.
  balanced_train_data <- train_raw

  balanced_weights <- rep(
    1,
    nrow(balanced_train_data)
  )


  baseline_model_balanced <- fit_cox_checked(
    baseline_formula,
    balanced_train_data
  )


  baseline_risk <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      baseline_model_balanced,
      newdata = test_data,
      type = "lp"
    )
  )


  baseline_concordance <- calculate_cindex(
    times = test_data[[time_col]],
    events = test_data[[response_col]],
    risk_scores = baseline_risk
  )

  baseline_cindex <- baseline_concordance$Cindex


  baseline_ph <- calculate_ph_test(
    baseline_model_balanced
  )

  baseline_ph_p <- if (!is.null(baseline_ph)) {
    unname(baseline_ph$table["GLOBAL", "p"])
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }


  ########################################################
  ################ Loop over biomarkers ##################
  ########################################################

  # Include the FIRST biomarker too.
  for (i in seq_len(ncol(data_Biomarker))) {

    colName <- names(data_Biomarker)[i]


    tryCatch({

      myBiomarker <- data_Biomarker[[i]]

      predictor_cols <- c(
        predictors,
        "Biomarker"
      )

      formula <- make_cox_formula(
        time_col,
        response_col,
        predictor_cols
      )


      temp_train <- train_raw

      temp_test <- test_data

      biomarker_values <- myBiomarker


      temp_train$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          temp_train$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]

      temp_test$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          temp_test$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]


      model_data <- balanced_train_data

      case_weights <- balanced_weights

      model_data$Biomarker <- biomarker_values[
        match(
          model_data$row_id,
          data$row_id
        )
      ]


      if (
        !is.finite(sd(model_data$Biomarker)) ||
        sd(model_data$Biomarker) == 0
      ) {
        stop("Biomarker is constant in this training split.")
      }


      cox_biomarker <- fit_cox_checked(
        formula,
        model_data
      )


      biomarker_risk <- as.numeric(
        predict(
          cox_biomarker,
          newdata = temp_test,
          type = "lp"
        )
      )


      biomarker_concordance <- calculate_cindex(
        times = temp_test[[time_col]],
        events = temp_test[[response_col]],
        risk_scores = biomarker_risk
      )

      cindex_biomarker <- biomarker_concordance$Cindex


      ####################################################
      ################ Likelihood-ratio test #############
      ####################################################

      # Same training rows and Breslow ties in both models.
      # This is the nested partial-likelihood ANOVA comparison.
      anova_chisq <- 2 * as.numeric(
        logLik(cox_biomarker) -
          logLik(baseline_model_balanced)
      )

      anova_df <- length(coef(cox_biomarker)) -
        length(coef(baseline_model_balanced))

      if (anova_chisq < -1e-6 || anova_df <= 0) {
        stop("Invalid nested-model likelihood-ratio comparison.")
      }

      anova_chisq <- max(0, anova_chisq)

      anova_cox <- pchisq(
        anova_chisq,
        df = anova_df,
        lower.tail = FALSE
      )


      ####################################################
      ################ Coefficient inference #############
      ####################################################

      summary_model <- summary(cox_biomarker)

      coef_matrix <- summary_model$coefficients

      ci_matrix <- summary_model$conf.int


      # Preserve familiar coefficient-column names for later tables.
      coef_df <- data.frame(
        Estimate = coef_matrix[, "coef"],

        SE = coef_matrix[, "se(coef)"],

        Wald_z = coef_matrix[, "z"],

        Pr = coef_matrix[, "Pr(>|z|)"],

        HR = ci_matrix[, "exp(coef)"],

        HR_lower95 = ci_matrix[, "lower .95"],

        HR_upper95 = ci_matrix[, "upper .95"],

        Predictor = rownames(coef_matrix),

        Seed = seed,

        Biomarker = colName,

        Response = response_col,

        row.names = NULL
      )


      # Preserve the original within-model FDR calculation.
      coef_df$FDR <- p.adjust(
        coef_df$Pr,
        method = "fdr"
      )


      marker_row <- coef_df[
        coef_df$Predictor == "Biomarker",
        ,
        drop = FALSE
      ]


      if (nrow(marker_row) != 1) {
        stop("Biomarker coefficient could not be identified.")
      }


      ####################################################
      ################ Proportional-hazards test #########
      ####################################################

      ph_test <- calculate_ph_test(
        cox_biomarker
      )

      global_ph_p <- NA_real_

      biomarker_ph_p <- NA_real_


      if (!is.null(ph_test)) {

        global_ph_p <-
          unname(ph_test$table["GLOBAL", "p"])

        if ("Biomarker" %in% rownames(ph_test$table)) {

          biomarker_ph_p <-
            unname(ph_test$table["Biomarker", "p"])
        }

        ph_results[[length(ph_results) + 1L]] <-
          data.frame(
            Seed = seed,
            Response = response_col,
            Biomarker = colName,

            Term = rownames(ph_test$table),

            Chisq = ph_test$table[, "chisq"],

            df = ph_test$table[, "df"],

            Pr = ph_test$table[, "p"],

            row.names = NULL
          )
      }


      ####################################################
      ################ Store results #####################
      ####################################################

      result_row <- data.frame(
        Seed = seed,

        Biomarker = colName,

        Response = response_col,

        Estimate = marker_row$Estimate,

        SE = marker_row$SE,

        Wald_z = marker_row$Wald_z,

        HR = marker_row$HR,

        HR_lower95 = marker_row$HR_lower95,

        HR_upper95 = marker_row$HR_upper95,

        Pr = marker_row$Pr,

        FDR = marker_row$FDR,


        Cindex_baseline = baseline_cindex,

        Cindex_biomarker = cindex_biomarker,

        Delta_Cindex =
          cindex_biomarker - baseline_cindex,


        Cindex_SE_baseline =
          baseline_concordance$SE,

        Cindex_SE_biomarker =
          biomarker_concordance$SE,

        Comparable_pairs =
          biomarker_concordance$Comparable_pairs,


        ANOVA_chisq = anova_chisq,

        ANOVA_df = anova_df,

        ANOVA_p_value = anova_cox,


        Train_AIC_baseline =
          AIC(baseline_model_balanced),

        Train_AIC_biomarker =
          AIC(cox_biomarker),

        Train_BIC_baseline =
          BIC(baseline_model_balanced),

        Train_BIC_biomarker =
          BIC(cox_biomarker),


        Train_logLik_baseline =
          as.numeric(logLik(baseline_model_balanced)),

        Train_logLik_biomarker =
          as.numeric(logLik(cox_biomarker)),


        PH_baseline_p = baseline_ph_p,

        PH_global_p = global_ph_p,

        PH_biomarker_p = biomarker_ph_p,


        Train_events =
          sum(model_data[[response_col]]),

        Test_events =
          sum(temp_test[[response_col]]),


        Significant =
          marker_row$Pr < individual_p_threshold,

        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )


      results_list[[length(results_list) + 1L]] <-
        result_row

      predictor_results[[length(predictor_results) + 1L]] <-
        coef_df


      prediction_key <- paste(
        seed,
        response_col,
        colName,
        sep = "_"
      )


      prediction_storage[[prediction_key]] <- list(
        time = temp_test[[time_col]],
        event = temp_test[[response_col]],

        baseline_risk = baseline_risk,
        biomarker_risk = biomarker_risk,

        cindex = cindex_biomarker,
        baseline_cindex = baseline_cindex,

        seed = seed,
        biomarker = colName,
        response = response_col,

        row_id = temp_test$row_id
      )

    }, error = function(e) {

      failed_models[[length(failed_models) + 1L]] <<-
        data.frame(
          Seed = seed,
          Response = response_col,
          Biomarker = colName,
          Reason = conditionMessage(e)
        )

      message(
        "Skipped seed ",
        seed,
        ", biomarker ",
        colName,
        ": ",
        conditionMessage(e)
      )
    })
  }

} # ---------------- END OF 50-SEED LOOP ----------------


###############################
#### Combine all results ######
###############################

results <- bind_rows(results_list)

predictor_results <- bind_rows(predictor_results)

ph_results <- bind_rows(ph_results)

failed_models <- bind_rows(failed_models)


if (nrow(failed_models) > 0) {

  write_xlsx(
    failed_models,
    "Individually Selected Predictors/Failed_Cox_Models.xlsx"
  )
}


if (nrow(results) == 0) {
  stop("No individual Cox models were successfully fitted.")
}


###############################
#### Summary across seeds #####
###############################

summary_results <-
  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Biomarker
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_splits = n(),

    Valid_Cindex_splits =
      sum(is.finite(Cindex_biomarker)),


    Mean_Estimate = safe_mean(Estimate),

    SD_Estimate = safe_sd(Estimate),

    Mean_SE = safe_mean(SE),

    Mean_Wald_z = safe_mean(Wald_z),


    Mean_HR = safe_mean(HR),

    Lower95_HR = safe_quantile(HR, 0.025),

    Upper95_HR = safe_quantile(HR, 0.975),


    Mean_Pr = safe_mean(Pr),

    Median_Pr = safe_median(Pr),

    Mean_FDR = safe_mean(FDR),


    Mean_Cindex_baseline =
      safe_mean(Cindex_baseline),

    Lower95_Cindex_baseline =
      safe_quantile(Cindex_baseline, 0.025),

    Upper95_Cindex_baseline =
      safe_quantile(Cindex_baseline, 0.975),


    Mean_Cindex_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Cindex_biomarker),

    Lower95_Cindex_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(Cindex_biomarker, 0.025),

    Upper95_Cindex_biomarker =
      safe_quantile(Cindex_biomarker, 0.975),


    Mean_Delta_Cindex =
      safe_mean(Delta_Cindex),

    Lower95_Delta_Cindex =
      safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta_Cindex =
      safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.975),


    Median_ANOVA =
      safe_median(ANOVA_p_value),


    Mean_Train_AIC_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_AIC_baseline),

    Mean_Train_AIC_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_AIC_biomarker),

    Mean_Train_BIC_baseline =
      safe_mean(Train_BIC_baseline),

    Mean_Train_BIC_biomarker =
      safe_mean(Train_BIC_biomarker),


    Median_PH_global_p =
      safe_median(PH_global_p),

    Median_PH_biomarker_p =
      safe_median(PH_biomarker_p),

    PH_biomarker_tested_splits =
      sum(is.finite(PH_biomarker_p)),

    PH_biomarker_significant_frequency =
      sum(PH_biomarker_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),


    Significant_frequency =
      sum(Significant, na.rm = TRUE),

    Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 * sum(Significant, na.rm = TRUE) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


###############################
##### Predictor summary #######
###############################

predictor_summary <-
  predictor_results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Biomarker,
    Predictor
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_splits = n(),

    Mean_Estimate = safe_mean(Estimate),

    SD_Estimate = safe_sd(Estimate),

    Mean_SE = safe_mean(SE),

    Mean_Wald_z = safe_mean(Wald_z),


    # Arithmetic mean of the per-split hazard ratios.
    Mean_HR = safe_mean(HR),

    Lower95_HR = safe_quantile(HR, 0.025),

    Upper95_HR = safe_quantile(HR, 0.975),


    Mean_Pr = safe_mean(Pr),

    Median_Pr = safe_median(Pr),

    Mean_FDR = safe_mean(FDR),


    Significant_frequency =
      sum(
        Pr < predictor_p_threshold,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    Significant_percent =
      100 *
      sum(
        Pr < predictor_p_threshold,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / n_seeds,


    FDR_Significant_frequency =
      sum(
        FDR < predictor_p_threshold,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

    FDR_Significant_percent =
      round(
        100 *
        sum(
          FDR < predictor_p_threshold,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_seeds,
        1
      ),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  mutate(
    HR_display = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_HR,
      Lower95_HR,
      Upper95_HR
    )
  )


###############################
##### Select Top 5 ############
###############################

robust_results <-
  summary_results %>%

  filter(
    Significant_frequency >= min_frequency,
    Mean_Delta_Cindex > 0
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(Significant_frequency),
    desc(Mean_Delta_Cindex),
    desc(Mean_Cindex_biomarker),
    Mean_Pr
  )


###############################
#### Display version ##########
###############################

robust_results_display <-
  robust_results %>%

  mutate(
    Mean_Cindex_baseline = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_Cindex_baseline,
      Lower95_Cindex_baseline,
      Upper95_Cindex_baseline
    ),

    Mean_Cindex_biomarker = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_Cindex_biomarker,
      Lower95_Cindex_biomarker,
      Upper95_Cindex_biomarker
    ),

    Mean_Delta_Cindex = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_Delta_Cindex,
      Lower95_Delta_Cindex,
      Upper95_Delta_Cindex
    )
  ) %>%

  select(
    Response,
    Biomarker,

    Successful_splits,

    Mean_Cindex_baseline,
    Mean_Cindex_biomarker,
    Mean_Delta_Cindex,

    Median_ANOVA,

    Median_PH_biomarker_p,

    Significant_frequency,
    Significant_percent
  )


top5 <-
  robust_results %>%
  slice_head(n = 5)


###############################
##### HTML table ##############
###############################

robust_widget <- datatable(
  robust_results_display,

  rownames = FALSE,

  caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
    style = paste(
      "caption-side: top;",
      "text-align: left;",
      "font-weight: bold;"
    ),

    paste(
      "Average Cox performance across",
      n_seeds,
      "random stratified 70/30 train/test splits"
    )
  ),

  extensions = "Buttons",

  options = list(
    pageLength = 50,
    autoWidth = TRUE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    dom = "Bfrtip",
    buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel"),
    order = list()
  )
)


numeric_columns <- names(
  robust_results_display
)[
  vapply(
    robust_results_display,
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]


if (length(numeric_columns) > 0) {

  robust_widget <- formatRound(
    robust_widget,
    columns = numeric_columns,
    digits = 3
  )
}


htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::tags$details(

    htmltools::tags$summary(
      style = "font-size:1.8em;",

      paste(
        "Robust Biomarkers Across",
        n_seeds,
        "Random Stratified 70/30 Splits"
      )
    ),

    htmltools::tags$p(
      paste(
        "Ranges are the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles across splits,",
        "not confidence intervals."
      )
    ),

    robust_widget
  )
)


###############################
##### Save Excel files ########
###############################

write_xlsx(
  results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Biomarkers_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  summary_results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Biomarkers_Summary.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  robust_results_display,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Robust_Biomarkers.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  predictor_results,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Predictor_Coefficients_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  predictor_summary,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Predictor_Coefficients_Summary.xlsx"
)

if (nrow(ph_results) > 0) {

  write_xlsx(
    ph_results,
    "Individually Selected Predictors/Proportional_Hazards_Tests.xlsx"
  )
}

saveRDS(
  prediction_storage,
  "Individually Selected Predictors/Individual_Cox_Predictions.rds"
)


###############################
##### Representative plots ####
###############################

cat(
  paste0(
    "<details><summary style='font-size:1.8em;'>",
    "Representative C-index Results (Top 5 Biomarkers)",
    "</summary><br>\n\n"
  )
)


if (nrow(top5) == 0) {

  cat(
    "No biomarkers met the specified robustness criteria.\n\n"
  )

} else {

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(top5))) {

    biomarker <- top5$Biomarker[i]

    target_cindex <- top5$Mean_Cindex_biomarker[i]


    tmp <-
      results %>%

      filter(
        Biomarker == biomarker,
        Response == top5$Response[i],
        is.finite(Cindex_biomarker)
      )


    if (nrow(tmp) == 0) {
      next
    }


    closest_seed <- tmp$Seed[
      which.min(
        abs(
          tmp$Cindex_biomarker - target_cindex
        )
      )
    ]


    representative_row <- tmp[
      tmp$Seed == closest_seed,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


    # A standard ROC curve is not appropriate here.
    # Display test C-index across splits and highlight
    # the split closest to the mean.
    representative_plot <-
      ggplot(
        tmp,
        aes(
          x = Seed,
          y = Cindex_biomarker
        )
      ) +

      geom_point(
        color = "#2166AC",
        alpha = 0.75,
        size = 2
      ) +

      geom_hline(
        yintercept = target_cindex,
        linetype = "dashed",
        color = "grey40"
      ) +

      geom_point(
        data = representative_row,
        color = "#B2182B",
        size = 3
      ) +

      coord_cartesian(
        ylim = c(0, 1)
      ) +

      theme_minimal(
        base_size = 12
      ) +

      labs(
        title = biomarker,

        subtitle = paste0(
          "Representative seed = ",
          closest_seed,
          " | Test C-index = ",
          sprintf(
            "%.3f",
            representative_row$Cindex_biomarker[1]
          )
        ),

        x = "Split seed",

        y = "Independent test C-index",

        caption = paste(
          "Dashed line: mean test C-index.",
          "Red point: representative split, for illustration only."
        )
      )


    print(representative_plot)

    cat("\n\n")
  }
}


cat("\n</details>\n")


###############################
##### Clean-up ################
###############################

# Keep data$row_id, splits, time_col and response_cols.
# Subsequent elastic-net and de-novo chunks reuse these objects.

rm(results_list)
```

```{r predictor-summaries, results='asis'}

    kable(

      ),
```
