```{r predictor-summaries, results='asis'}
    ) %>%

      kable_styling(
        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "hover",
          "condensed",
          "responsive"
        ),

        full_width = FALSE,

        position = "center"
      ) %>%

      column_spec(
        1,
        bold = TRUE
      ) %>%

      row_spec(
        0,
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "white",
        background = "black"
      ) %>%

      print()


    cat(
      paste0(
        "<p><small>",
        "Hazard_Ratio reports the arithmetic mean HR and ",
        "the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles across splits. ",
        "These ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. ",
        "Within-fit HR confidence intervals are available in ",
        "Predictor_Coefficients_AllSeeds.xlsx. ",
        "Mean_FDR retains the original within-model correction. ",
        "Median p-values, mean FDR and median PH p-values are ",
        "descriptive summaries, not pooled statistical tests. ",
        "A nonsignificant PH test does not prove proportional hazards.",
        "</small></p>"
      )
    )


    cat("</div></details><br>")
  }


  cat("</div></details><br>")
}
```




A categorical predictor with four levels produces three coefficients when treatment contrasts are used. Each coefficient compares that category with the reference category. In Cox regression, exponentiating the coefficient gives the hazard ratio relative to the reference category.

## Package Loading to perform Elastic Net

```{r cox-elastic-packages, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
library(survival)
library(glmnet)
library(rsample)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(broom)

# Biomarkers and the adjustment molecule were already standardized.
# Preserve the preceding section's scaling convention:
# standardize = FALSE in glmnet.
```

## Performing Elastic Net and obtaining the cross-validation plots

The mandatory-only machine-learning baseline is a Ridge Cox model.

The full Cox elastic-net model contains mandatory predictors with zero penalty and candidate biomarkers with a nonzero penalty. Internal cross-validation selects lambda using the C-index.

All models reuse the same training/test splits created in the individual-biomarker section. Test observations are used only for performance evaluation.

The de-novo analysis refits each selected biomarker panel, together with all mandatory predictors, using ordinary Cox regression.

```{r cox-elastic-analysis, results='asis'}
############################################################
################ Elastic Net initialization ################
############################################################

library(glmnet)
library(survival)
library(rsample)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(broom)


############################################################
################ User settings #############################
############################################################

response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]

response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

time_col <- colnames(data)[columns_time]

exclude_columns <- c(
  response_cols,
  time_col,
  "row_id",
  ".split_event"
)

main_predictors <- setdiff(
  colnames(data)[columns_predictors],
  exclude_columns
)

biomarker_names <- setdiff(
  names(data_Biomarker),
  exclude_columns
)

# Use the values defined in the first section:
# alpha_values <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)
# nfolds_values <- c(10, 20)
# n_seeds <- 50

baseline_nfolds <- 10L

if (
  !exists("splits") ||
  length(splits) != n_seeds
) {
  stop("Run the first Cox section to create the shared splits.")
}


required_helpers <- c(
  "make_cox_formula",
  "calculate_cindex",
  "fit_cox_checked",
  "calculate_ph_test",
  "safe_mean",
  "safe_median",
  "safe_sd",
  "safe_quantile",
  "escape_html"
)

missing_helpers <- required_helpers[
  !vapply(
    required_helpers,
    exists,
    logical(1),
    mode = "function"
  )
]

if (length(missing_helpers) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Run the first Cox section first. Missing helpers: ",
    paste(missing_helpers, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (
  length(intersect(main_predictors, biomarker_names)) > 0
) {
  stop("Mandatory predictors and candidate biomarkers overlap.")
}


############################################################
############ Preserve individual-biomarker results #########
############################################################

individual_results <- results

individual_summary_results <- summary_results


############################################################
################ Storage ###################################
############################################################

results_list <- list()

coef_list <- list()

selected_variables_list <- list()

elastic_prediction_storage <- list()

baseline_results_list <- list()

baseline_coef_list <- list()

design_mapping_list <- list()

warnings <- character()

failure_list <- list()


############################################################
############ Store cv.glmnet objects ########################
############################################################

cv_models <- list()

baseline_cv_models <- list()

cv_fold_storage <- list()


############################################################
############### De novo refitting storage ##################
############################################################

refit_results_list <- list()

refit_coef_list <- list()

refit_prediction_storage <- list()

refit_ph_list <- list()


############################################################
################ Additional helpers #########################
############################################################

make_cox_folds <- function(events, k, seed_value) {

  event_counts <- table(
    factor(events, levels = c(0, 1))
  )

  if (any(event_counts < k)) {
    stop(
      "Not enough events or censored observations for ",
      k,
      " folds with both represented in every fold."
    )
  }

  set.seed(seed_value)

  fold_id <- integer(length(events))

  for (event_value in c(0, 1)) {

    indices <- which(events == event_value)

    fold_id[indices] <- sample(
      rep(
        seq_len(k),
        length.out = length(indices)
      )
    )
  }

  fold_id
}


fit_cox_cv <- function(
  x,
  y,
  alpha,
  fold_id,
  penalty_factor
) {

  arguments <- list(
    x = x,
    y = y,

    family = "cox",

    alpha = alpha,

    nfolds = max(fold_id),

    foldid = fold_id,

    type.measure = "C",

    penalty.factor = penalty_factor,

    standardize = FALSE
  )

  # Older glmnet versions use Breslow ties automatically.
  # Newer versions may offer a choice: explicitly match coxph.
  if (
    "cox.ties" %in%
      names(formals(glmnet::glmnet))
  ) {
    arguments$cox.ties <- "breslow"
  }

  cvfit <- withCallingHandlers(

    do.call(
      glmnet::cv.glmnet,
      arguments
    ),

    warning = function(w) {

      if (
        grepl(
          "converg|infinite|overflow|numerical",
          conditionMessage(w),
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )
      ) {
        stop(
          conditionMessage(w),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  )

  if (
    !is.finite(cvfit$lambda.min) ||
    !any(is.finite(cvfit$cvm))
  ) {
    stop("Cox cross-validation did not return valid results.")
  }

  cvfit
}


get_cox_diagnostics <- function(fit) {

  model_summary <- summary(fit)

  c(
    Train_logLik = as.numeric(logLik(fit)),

    Train_AIC = AIC(fit),

    Train_BIC = BIC(fit),

    Train_Cindex =
      unname(model_summary$concordance[1]),

    Train_LR_p =
      unname(model_summary$logtest["pvalue"]),

    Train_Wald_p =
      unname(model_summary$waldtest["pvalue"]),

    Train_Score_p =
      unname(model_summary$sctest["pvalue"]),

    Training_events = fit$nevent,

    Coefficients = length(coef(fit)),

    Events_per_coefficient =
      fit$nevent / length(coef(fit))
  )
}


record_failure <- function(
  seed,
  response,
  alpha,
  folds,
  stage,
  reason
) {

  failure_list[[length(failure_list) + 1L]] <<-
    data.frame(
      Seed = seed,
      Response = response,
      Alpha = alpha,
      nfolds = folds,
      Stage = stage,
      Reason = reason,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
}


############################################################
################ Warning handler ###########################
############################################################

warning_context <- "Initialization"

capture_warning <- function(w) {

  warnings <<- c(
    warnings,
    paste0(
      warning_context,
      ": ",
      conditionMessage(w)
    )
  )

  invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
}


############################################################
############## Start warning capture #######################
############################################################

withCallingHandlers({

  for (seed in seq_len(n_seeds)) {

    cat("\n=========================\n")
    cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
    cat("=========================\n")

    warning_context <- paste("Seed", seed)


    ########################################################
    ########### Reuse predefined stratified split ###########
    ########################################################

    split <- splits[[seed]]

    train_raw <- rsample::training(split)

    test_data <- rsample::testing(split)

    train_raw$.split_event <- NULL

    test_data$.split_event <- NULL


    ########################################################
    ########### Training data / weights ####################
    ########################################################

    # Standard Cox analysis: retain all training observations.
    train_data <- train_raw

    sample_weights <- rep(
      1,
      nrow(train_data)
    )

    train_events <- train_data[[response_col]]

    test_events <- test_data[[response_col]]

    train_times <- train_data[[time_col]]

    test_times <- test_data[[time_col]]

    if (
      any(!is.finite(train_times)) ||
      any(!is.finite(test_times)) ||
      any(train_times <= 0) ||
      any(test_times <= 0)
    ) {
      stop("Follow-up times must be finite and strictly positive.")
    }

    y_train <- survival::Surv(
      train_times,
      train_events
    )

    y_test <- survival::Surv(
      test_times,
      test_events
    )


    ########################################################
    ########### Check predictor eligibility #################
    ########################################################

    for (variable in main_predictors) {

      if (
        length(unique(train_data[[variable]])) < 2
      ) {
        stop(
          "Constant mandatory predictor in seed ",
          seed,
          ": ",
          variable
        )
      }

      if (is.factor(train_data[[variable]])) {

        if (
          any(
            table(train_data[[variable]]) == 0
          )
        ) {
          stop(
            "A categorical level is absent from training seed ",
            seed,
            ": ",
            variable
          )
        }
      }
    }

    # A biomarker may vary globally but be constant within a split.
    active_biomarkers <- biomarker_names[
      vapply(
        train_data[, biomarker_names, drop = FALSE],

        function(x) {
          is.numeric(x) &&
            all(is.finite(x)) &&
            sd(x) > 0
        },

        logical(1)
      )
    ]

    if (!length(active_biomarkers)) {
      stop("No varying biomarkers in training seed ", seed)
    }


    ########################################################
    ########### Design matrices #############################
    ########################################################

    predictor_variables <- c(
      main_predictors,
      active_biomarkers
    )

    x_train <- as.data.frame(
      train_data[, predictor_variables, drop = FALSE]
    )

    x_test <- as.data.frame(
      test_data[, predictor_variables, drop = FALSE]
    )

    # Temporary safe names are used ONLY for matrix construction.
    # Original names remain unchanged in train_data/test_data.
    matrix_aliases <- sprintf(
      "X%04d",
      seq_along(predictor_variables)
    )

    names(x_train) <- matrix_aliases

    names(x_test) <- matrix_aliases

    categorical_aliases <- names(x_train)[
      vapply(x_train, is.factor, logical(1))
    ]

    matrix_contrasts <- NULL

    if (length(categorical_aliases) > 0) {

      matrix_contrasts <- lapply(
        setNames(
          categorical_aliases,
          categorical_aliases
        ),

        function(variable) {
          contrasts(
            x_train[[variable]],
            contrasts = TRUE
          )
        }
      )
    }

    # Construct K-1 factor contrasts, then remove the matrix
    # intercept. The Cox model itself has no intercept.
    train_design <- model.matrix(
      ~ .,
      data = x_train,
      contrasts.arg = matrix_contrasts
    )

    test_design <- model.matrix(
      ~ .,
      data = x_test,
      contrasts.arg = matrix_contrasts
    )

    design_assign <- attr(
      train_design,
      "assign"
    )[-1]

    x_train_matrix <- train_design[
      ,
      -1,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    x_test_matrix <- test_design[
      ,
      colnames(x_train_matrix),
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    if (
      any(!is.finite(x_train_matrix)) ||
      any(!is.finite(x_test_matrix))
    ) {
      stop("Non-finite values in the predictor matrices.")
    }

    # Map each matrix column back to its original variable.
    original_variable <- predictor_variables[
      design_assign
    ]

    # Human-readable names, including factor-level suffixes.
    predictor_names <- vapply(
      seq_along(design_assign),

      function(j) {

        alias <- matrix_aliases[
          design_assign[j]
        ]

        suffix <- substring(
          colnames(x_train_matrix)[j],
          nchar(alias) + 1L
        )

        paste0(
          original_variable[j],
          suffix
        )
      },

      character(1)
    )

    columns_predictors_x <- which(
      original_variable %in% main_predictors
    )

    mandatory_flags <-
      original_variable %in% main_predictors

    if (length(columns_predictors_x) < 2) {
      stop(
        "The glmnet Ridge baseline requires at least two design columns."
      )
    }

    design_mapping_list[[
      length(design_mapping_list) + 1L
    ]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Matrix_column = colnames(x_train_matrix),
        Variable = predictor_names,
        Original_variable = original_variable,
        Mandatory = mandatory_flags
      )


    ########################################################
    ########### Shared internal CV folds ####################
    ########################################################

    fold_ids <- list()

    for (
      k in sort(
        unique(
          c(nfolds_values, baseline_nfolds)
        )
      )
    ) {

      fold_ids[[as.character(k)]] <-
        make_cox_folds(
          events = train_events,
          k = k,
          seed_value = seed + 1000L * k
        )
    }

    cv_fold_storage[[
      paste(response_col, seed, sep = "_")
    ]] <- list(
      row_id = train_data$row_id,
      fold_ids = fold_ids
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Baseline Ridge Cox ####################
    ########################################################

    warning_context <- paste(
      "Seed",
      seed,
      "baseline Ridge Cox"
    )

    baseline_matrix <- x_train_matrix[
      ,
      columns_predictors_x,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    baseline_test_matrix <- x_test_matrix[
      ,
      columns_predictors_x,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    baseline_cvfit <- fit_cox_cv(
      x = baseline_matrix,

      y = y_train,

      alpha = 0,

      fold_id = fold_ids[[
        as.character(baseline_nfolds)
      ]],

      # Genuine Ridge comparator: mandatory predictors are
      # all included but receive a Ridge penalty.
      penalty_factor = rep(
        1,
        ncol(baseline_matrix)
      )
    )

    baseline_lambda <-
      baseline_cvfit$lambda.min

    baseline_cv_models[[
      paste(response_col, seed, sep = "_")
    ]] <- baseline_cvfit

    # cv.glmnet already fits a full-training glmnet path.
    baseline_model <-
      baseline_cvfit$glmnet.fit

    baseline_predictions <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        baseline_model,

        newx = baseline_test_matrix,

        s = baseline_lambda,

        type = "link"
      )
    )

    baseline_concordance <- calculate_cindex(
      times = test_times,
      events = test_events,
      risk_scores = baseline_predictions
    )

    baseline_cindex <-
      baseline_concordance$Cindex

    baseline_results_list[[
      length(baseline_results_list) + 1L
    ]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col,
        nfolds = baseline_nfolds,
        Lambda_min = baseline_lambda,
        Lambda_1se = baseline_cvfit$lambda.1se,
        Baseline_Cindex = baseline_cindex,
        Cindex_SE = baseline_concordance$SE,
        Comparable_pairs =
          baseline_concordance$Comparable_pairs
      )

    baseline_coefs <- as.matrix(
      coef(
        baseline_model,
        s = baseline_lambda
      )
    )[, 1]

    baseline_coef_list[[
      length(baseline_coef_list) + 1L
    ]] <-
      data.frame(
        Seed = seed,
        Response = response_col,
        Variable = predictor_names[
          columns_predictors_x
        ],
        Coefficient = as.numeric(baseline_coefs)
      )


    ########################################################
    ########### Baseline ordinary Cox for refits ############
    ########################################################

    baseline_formula <- make_cox_formula(
      time_col,
      response_col,
      main_predictors
    )

    baseline_cox <- fit_cox_checked(
      baseline_formula,
      train_data
    )

    baseline_predictions_cox <- as.numeric(
      predict(
        baseline_cox,
        newdata = test_data,
        type = "lp"
      )
    )

    baseline_concordance_cox <- calculate_cindex(
      times = test_times,
      events = test_events,
      risk_scores = baseline_predictions_cox
    )

    baseline_cindex_cox <-
      baseline_concordance_cox$Cindex

    baseline_diagnostics <-
      get_cox_diagnostics(baseline_cox)

    baseline_ph <- calculate_ph_test(
      baseline_cox
    )

    baseline_ph_p <- if (!is.null(baseline_ph)) {
      unname(baseline_ph$table["GLOBAL", "p"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }


    ########################################################
    ########## Loop over nfolds #############################
    ########################################################

    for (nfolds_val in nfolds_values) {


      ######################################################
      ########### Loop over alpha ##########################
      ######################################################

      for (alpha_val in alpha_values) {

        warning_context <- paste(
          "Seed", seed,
          "alpha", alpha_val,
          "folds", nfolds_val
        )

        tryCatch({

          penalty.factor <- rep(
            1,
            ncol(x_train_matrix)
          )

          penalty.factor[
            columns_predictors_x
          ] <- 0


          ##################################################
          ################ Fit Cox Elastic Net #############
          ##################################################

          cvfit <- fit_cox_cv(
            x = x_train_matrix,
            y = y_train,
            alpha = alpha_val,

            fold_id = fold_ids[[
              as.character(nfolds_val)
            ]],

            penalty_factor = penalty.factor
          )

          lambda_min <- cvfit$lambda.min

          lambda_1se <- cvfit$lambda.1se

          lambda_index <- which.min(
            abs(cvfit$lambda - lambda_min)
          )

          cv_cindex <- cvfit$cvm[lambda_index]

          # With type.measure="C", lambda.min identifies
          # the best CV C-index: higher C is better.


          ##################################################
          ############ Store CV model ######################
          ##################################################

          cv_key <- paste(
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            seed,
            sep = "_"
          )

          cv_models[[cv_key]] <- cvfit


          ##################################################
          ################ Final model #####################
          ##################################################

          model <- cvfit$glmnet.fit


          ##################################################
          ################ Test predictions ################
          ##################################################

          predictions <- as.numeric(
            predict(
              model,
              newx = x_test_matrix,
              s = lambda_min,
              type = "link"
            )
          )

          concordance_result <- calculate_cindex(
            times = test_times,
            events = test_events,
            risk_scores = predictions
          )

          cindex_value <-
            concordance_result$Cindex

          delta_cindex <-
            cindex_value - baseline_cindex


          ##################################################
          ######## Number of selected predictors ###########
          ##################################################

          coefficient_matrix <- as.matrix(
            coef(
              model,
              s = lambda_min
            )
          )

          coef_vector <- coefficient_matrix[, 1]

          # IMPORTANT: Cox coefficients have no intercept row.
          # Do not discard coef_vector[1].
          nonzero_flags <- coef_vector != 0

          retained_flags <-
            nonzero_flags | mandatory_flags

          selected_predictors <- sum(
            retained_flags
          )

          selected_biomarkers <- unique(
            original_variable[
              nonzero_flags & !mandatory_flags
            ]
          )

          all_predictors <- unique(
            c(
              main_predictors,
              selected_biomarkers
            )
          )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store model performance #################
          ##################################################

          results_list[[
            length(results_list) + 1L
          ]] <-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,

              Lambda_min = lambda_min,
              Lambda_1se = lambda_1se,
              CV_Cindex = cv_cindex,

              Baseline_Cindex = baseline_cindex,

              ElasticNet_Cindex = cindex_value,

              Delta_Cindex = delta_cindex,

              Baseline_Cindex_SE =
                baseline_concordance$SE,

              ElasticNet_Cindex_SE =
                concordance_result$SE,

              Comparable_pairs =
                concordance_result$Comparable_pairs,

              # Includes mandatory design columns.
              Selected_predictors =
                selected_predictors,

              # Excludes mandatory predictors.
              Selected_biomarkers =
                length(selected_biomarkers),

              Biomarker_panel = paste(
                selected_biomarkers,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store coefficients ######################
          ##################################################

          coef_df <- data.frame(
            Seed = seed,
            Response = response_col,
            Alpha = alpha_val,
            nfolds = nfolds_val,

            Variable = predictor_names,

            Original_variable = original_variable,

            Coefficient = as.numeric(coef_vector),

            Nonzero = as.logical(nonzero_flags),

            Mandatory = mandatory_flags,

            Selected = as.logical(retained_flags),

            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )

          coef_list[[
            length(coef_list) + 1L
          ]] <- coef_df


          ##################################################
          ######## Store selected variables ################
          ##################################################

          selected_df <-
            coef_df %>%

            filter(Selected) %>%

            select(
              Seed,
              Response,
              Alpha,
              nfolds,
              Variable,
              Original_variable,
              Mandatory
            )

          selected_variables_list[[
            length(selected_variables_list) + 1L
          ]] <- selected_df


          ##################################################
          ######## Store Elastic Net predictions ###########
          ##################################################

          prediction_key <- paste(
            seed,
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            sep = "_"
          )

          elastic_prediction_storage[[
            prediction_key
          ]] <- list(
            time = test_times,
            event = test_events,

            risk = predictions,

            baseline_risk = baseline_predictions,

            cindex = cindex_value,

            baseline_cindex = baseline_cindex,

            row_id = test_data$row_id,

            seed = seed,
            response = response_col,
            alpha = alpha_val,
            nfolds = nfolds_val
          )


          ##################################################
          ############### De novo Cox refit ################
          ##################################################

          # Original variable names are obtained directly
          # from the design-column mapping, avoiding
          # unreliable prefix matching of dummy names.
          predictor_vars <- selected_biomarkers

          full_formula <- make_cox_formula(
            time_col,
            response_col,
            all_predictors
          )


          ##################################################
          ############ Fit and evaluate full Cox ###########
          ##################################################

          refit_attempt <- tryCatch({

            full_cox <- fit_cox_checked(
              full_formula,
              train_data
            )

            full_predictions <- as.numeric(
              predict(
                full_cox,
                newdata = test_data,
                type = "lp"
              )
            )

            full_concordance <- calculate_cindex(
              times = test_times,
              events = test_events,
              risk_scores = full_predictions
            )

            full_diagnostics <-
              get_cox_diagnostics(full_cox)


            ################################################
            ############ Likelihood-ratio test #############
            ################################################

            anova_df <- length(coef(full_cox)) -
              length(coef(baseline_cox))

            if (anova_df == 0) {

              anova_chisq <- 0

              anova_p <- NA_real_

            } else {

              anova_chisq <- 2 * as.numeric(
                logLik(full_cox) -
                  logLik(baseline_cox)
              )

              if (anova_chisq < -1e-6) {
                stop("Invalid nested-model partial-likelihood comparison.")
              }

              anova_chisq <- max(
                0,
                anova_chisq
              )

              anova_p <- pchisq(
                anova_chisq,
                df = anova_df,
                lower.tail = FALSE
              )
            }


            ################################################
            ############ Proportional-hazards test ##########
            ################################################

            full_ph <- calculate_ph_test(full_cox)

            full_ph_p <- if (!is.null(full_ph)) {

              unname(
                full_ph$table["GLOBAL", "p"]
              )

            } else {

              NA_real_
            }


            ################################################
            ############ Model coefficients ################
            ################################################

            tidy_model <-
              broom::tidy(
                full_cox,
                conf.int = TRUE,
                exponentiate = FALSE
              ) %>%

              mutate(
                # Normalize presentation of nonstandard names
                # for joining with selection-frequency tables.
                term = gsub(
                  "`",
                  "",
                  term,
                  fixed = TRUE
                ),

                HR = exp(estimate),

                HR_lower95 = exp(conf.low),

                HR_upper95 = exp(conf.high),

                FDR = p.adjust(
                  p.value,
                  method = "fdr"
                ),

                Seed = seed,
                Response = response_col,
                Alpha = alpha_val,
                nfolds = nfolds_val
              )


            list(
              ok = TRUE,

              reason = "",

              predictions = full_predictions,

              concordance = full_concordance,

              diagnostics = full_diagnostics,

              anova_chisq = anova_chisq,

              anova_df = anova_df,

              anova_p = anova_p,

              ph = full_ph,

              ph_p = full_ph_p,

              coefficients = tidy_model
            )

          }, error = function(e) {

            list(
              ok = FALSE,
              reason = conditionMessage(e)
            )
          })


          ##################################################
          ######## Handle failed de-novo fits ##############
          ##################################################

          if (refit_attempt$ok) {

            full_predictions <-
              refit_attempt$predictions

            full_concordance <-
              refit_attempt$concordance

            full_diagnostics <-
              refit_attempt$diagnostics

            anova_chisq <-
              refit_attempt$anova_chisq

            anova_df <-
              refit_attempt$anova_df

            anova_p <-
              refit_attempt$anova_p

            full_ph_p <-
              refit_attempt$ph_p

            refit_coef_list[[
              length(refit_coef_list) + 1L
            ]] <- refit_attempt$coefficients


            if (!is.null(refit_attempt$ph)) {

              ph_table <- refit_attempt$ph$table

              refit_ph_list[[
                length(refit_ph_list) + 1L
              ]] <-
                data.frame(
                  Seed = seed,
                  Response = response_col,
                  Alpha = alpha_val,
                  nfolds = nfolds_val,

                  Term = rownames(ph_table),

                  Chisq = ph_table[, "chisq"],

                  df = ph_table[, "df"],

                  Pr = ph_table[, "p"],

                  row.names = NULL
                )
            }

          } else {

            record_failure(
              seed,
              response_col,
              alpha_val,
              nfolds_val,
              "De_novo_Cox",
              refit_attempt$reason
            )

            full_predictions <- rep(
              NA_real_,
              length(test_times)
            )

            full_concordance <- list(
              Cindex = NA_real_,
              SE = NA_real_,
              Comparable_pairs = NA_real_
            )

            full_diagnostics <- setNames(
              rep(
                NA_real_,
                length(baseline_diagnostics)
              ),
              names(baseline_diagnostics)
            )

            anova_chisq <- NA_real_

            anova_df <- NA_real_

            anova_p <- NA_real_

            full_ph_p <- NA_real_
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Store refitted performance ##############
          ##################################################

          refit_results_list[[
            length(refit_results_list) + 1L
          ]] <-
            data.frame(
              Seed = seed,
              Response = response_col,
              Alpha = alpha_val,
              nfolds = nfolds_val,

              Status = if (refit_attempt$ok) {
                "ok"
              } else {
                "failed"
              },

              Failure_reason =
                refit_attempt$reason,

              Baseline_Cindex =
                baseline_cindex_cox,

              Refit_Cindex =
                full_concordance$Cindex,

              Delta_Cindex =
                full_concordance$Cindex -
                baseline_cindex_cox,

              Baseline_Cindex_SE =
                baseline_concordance_cox$SE,

              Refit_Cindex_SE =
                full_concordance$SE,

              ANOVA_chisq = anova_chisq,

              ANOVA_df = anova_df,

              ANOVA_p = anova_p,

              PH_baseline_p = baseline_ph_p,

              PH_global_p = full_ph_p,

              Train_AIC_baseline =
                unname(
                  baseline_diagnostics["Train_AIC"]
                ),

              Train_AIC_full =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_AIC"]
                ),

              Train_BIC_baseline =
                unname(
                  baseline_diagnostics["Train_BIC"]
                ),

              Train_BIC_full =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_BIC"]
                ),

              Train_logLik_baseline =
                unname(
                  baseline_diagnostics["Train_logLik"]
                ),

              Train_logLik_full =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_logLik"]
                ),

              Train_Cindex_baseline =
                unname(
                  baseline_diagnostics["Train_Cindex"]
                ),

              Train_Cindex_full =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_Cindex"]
                ),

              Train_LR_p =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_LR_p"]
                ),

              Train_Wald_p =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_Wald_p"]
                ),

              Train_Score_p =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Train_Score_p"]
                ),

              Events_per_coefficient =
                unname(
                  full_diagnostics["Events_per_coefficient"]
                ),

              # Added biomarkers, excluding mandatory predictors.
              Number_predictors =
                length(selected_biomarkers),

              Selected_biomarkers = paste(
                selected_biomarkers,
                collapse = "; "
              ),

              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )


          ##################################################
          ######## Store refitted predictions ##############
          ##################################################

          refit_prediction_storage[[
            prediction_key
          ]] <- list(
            time = test_times,
            event = test_events,

            risk = full_predictions,

            baseline_risk =
              baseline_predictions_cox,

            cindex =
              full_concordance$Cindex,

            baseline_cindex =
              baseline_cindex_cox,

            row_id = test_data$row_id,

            status = if (refit_attempt$ok) {
              "ok"
            } else {
              "failed"
            },

            seed = seed,
            response = response_col,
            alpha = alpha_val,
            nfolds = nfolds_val
          )

        }, error = function(e) {

          record_failure(
            seed,
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            "Elastic_net",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )

          message(
            "Failed seed ",
            seed,
            ", alpha ",
            alpha_val,
            ", folds ",
            nfolds_val,
            ": ",
            conditionMessage(e)
          )
        })

      } # End alpha loop

    } # End nfolds loop

  } # End seed loop

}, warning = capture_warning)


############################################################
################ Combine all results #######################
############################################################

results <- bind_rows(results_list)

coefficients_df <- bind_rows(coef_list)

selected_variables <- bind_rows(
  selected_variables_list
)

baseline_results <- bind_rows(
  baseline_results_list
)

baseline_coefficients <- bind_rows(
  baseline_coef_list
)

design_mapping <- bind_rows(
  design_mapping_list
)

failed_models_elastic <- bind_rows(
  failure_list
)


if (nrow(results) == 0) {

  print(failed_models_elastic)

  stop("No elastic-net Cox models were successfully fitted.")
}


############################################################
############### Variable selection frequency ###############
############################################################

# Use the complete coefficient table so variables with
# zero selection frequency are retained when eligible.
selection_frequency <-
  coefficients_df %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds,
    Variable,
    Original_variable,
    Mandatory
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Eligible_fits = n_distinct(Seed),

    Selected_splits = sum(Selected),

    Selection_frequency =
      100 * sum(Selected) / n_seeds,

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
############ Combine de novo refitting results #############
############################################################

refit_results <- bind_rows(
  refit_results_list
)

refit_coefficients <- bind_rows(
  refit_coef_list
)

refit_ph_results <- bind_rows(
  refit_ph_list
)


############################################################
############### De novo summary ############################
############################################################

refit_summary <- tibble()

refit_coefficients_summary <- tibble()


if (nrow(refit_results) > 0) {

  refit_counts <-
    refit_results %>%

    group_by(
      Response,
      Alpha,
      nfolds
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      Attempted_refits = n(),

      Successful_refits = sum(Status == "ok"),

      Failed_refits = sum(Status != "ok"),

      .groups = "drop"
    )


  refit_performance_summary <-
    refit_results %>%

    filter(Status == "ok") %>%

    group_by(
      Response,
      Alpha,
      nfolds
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      Valid_Cindex_splits =
        sum(is.finite(Refit_Cindex)),

      Mean_Baseline_Cindex =
        safe_mean(Baseline_Cindex),

      Lower95_Baseline =
        safe_quantile(Baseline_Cindex, 0.025),

      Upper95_Baseline =
        safe_quantile(Baseline_Cindex, 0.975),

      Mean_Refit_Cindex =
        safe_mean(Refit_Cindex),

      Lower95_Refit =
        safe_quantile(Refit_Cindex, 0.025),

      Upper95_Refit =
        safe_quantile(Refit_Cindex, 0.975),

      Mean_Delta_Cindex =
        safe_mean(Delta_Cindex),

      Lower95_Delta =
        safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.025),

      Upper95_Delta =
        safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.975),

      Median_ANOVA =
        safe_median(ANOVA_p),

      Significant_ANOVA =
        100 *
        sum(
          ANOVA_p < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) / n_seeds,

      Median_PH_global_p =
        safe_median(PH_global_p),

      PH_tested_splits =
        sum(is.finite(PH_global_p)),

      PH_significant_frequency =
        sum(
          PH_global_p < 0.05,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),

      Mean_Selected =
        safe_mean(Number_predictors),

      SD_Selected =
        safe_sd(Number_predictors),

      Mean_Train_AIC_baseline =
        safe_mean(Train_AIC_baseline),

      Mean_Train_AIC_full =
        safe_mean(Train_AIC_full),

      Mean_Train_BIC_baseline =
        safe_mean(Train_BIC_baseline),

      Mean_Train_BIC_full =
        safe_mean(Train_BIC_full),

      Mean_Events_per_coefficient =
        safe_mean(Events_per_coefficient),

      .groups = "drop"
    )


  refit_summary <-
    refit_counts %>%

    left_join(
      refit_performance_summary,

      by = c(
        "Response",
        "Alpha",
        "nfolds"
      )
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      desc(Mean_Refit_Cindex),
      desc(Mean_Delta_Cindex)
    )
}


############################################################
############### Refit coefficient summary ##################
############################################################

if (nrow(refit_coefficients) > 0) {

  refit_coefficients_summary <-
    refit_coefficients %>%

    group_by(
      Response,
      Alpha,
      nfolds,
      term
    ) %>%

    summarise(
      Estimated_splits =
        n_distinct(Seed),

      Mean_Beta =
        safe_mean(estimate),

      SD_Beta =
        safe_sd(estimate),

      Mean_SE =
        safe_mean(std.error),

      Mean_Wald_z =
        safe_mean(statistic),

      Mean_HR =
        safe_mean(HR),

      Lower95_HR =
        safe_quantile(HR, 0.025),

      Upper95_HR =
        safe_quantile(HR, 0.975),

      Median_p =
        safe_median(p.value),

      Mean_FDR =
        safe_mean(FDR),

      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


############################################################
################ Performance summary #######################
############################################################

summary_results <-
  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Alpha,
    nfolds
  ) %>%

  summarise(
    Successful_splits =
      n_distinct(Seed),

    Valid_Cindex_splits =
      sum(is.finite(ElasticNet_Cindex)),

    Mean_Cindex =
      safe_mean(ElasticNet_Cindex),

    Lower95_Cindex =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_Cindex, 0.025),

    Upper95_Cindex =
      safe_quantile(ElasticNet_Cindex, 0.975),

    Mean_Baseline_Cindex =
      safe_mean(Baseline_Cindex),

    Lower95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_Cindex, 0.025),

    Upper95_Baseline =
      safe_quantile(Baseline_Cindex, 0.975),

    Mean_Delta_Cindex =
      safe_mean(Delta_Cindex),

    Lower95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.025),

    Upper95_Delta =
      safe_quantile(Delta_Cindex, 0.975),

    Mean_CV_Cindex =
      safe_mean(CV_Cindex),

    Mean_Lambda_min =
      safe_mean(Lambda_min),

    SD_Lambda_min =
      safe_sd(Lambda_min),

    Mean_Lambda_1se =
      safe_mean(Lambda_1se),

    SD_Lambda_1se =
      safe_sd(Lambda_1se),

    # Includes mandatory design columns.
    Mean_Selected =
      safe_mean(Selected_predictors),

    SD_Selected =
      safe_sd(Selected_predictors),

    # Candidate biomarkers only.
    Mean_Selected_biomarkers =
      safe_mean(Selected_biomarkers),

    SD_Selected_biomarkers =
      safe_sd(Selected_biomarkers),

    .groups = "drop"
  )


############################################################
################ Sort models ###############################
############################################################

# Descriptive ordering only, not test-based model selection.
summary_results <-
  summary_results %>%

  arrange(
    desc(Mean_Cindex),
    desc(Mean_Delta_Cindex),
    Mean_Selected
  )


############################################################
############ Choose configurations using training CV #######
############################################################

best_models_cv <-
  results %>%

  group_by(
    Response,
    Seed
  ) %>%

  arrange(
    desc(CV_Cindex),
    Alpha,
    nfolds,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%

  slice_head(n = 1) %>%

  ungroup()


############################################################
################ Save detailed results #####################
############################################################

dir.create(
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

write_xlsx(
  results,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/ElasticNet_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  coefficients_df,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/ElasticNet_Coefficients_AllSeeds.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  selection_frequency,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Selection_Frequency.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  best_models_cv,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/CV_Chosen_Models.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  baseline_results,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Ridge_Baseline_Results.xlsx"
)

write_xlsx(
  baseline_coefficients,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Ridge_Baseline_Coefficients.xlsx"
)

if (nrow(refit_results) > 0) {
  write_xlsx(
    refit_results,
    "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Refit_AllSeeds.xlsx"
  )
}

if (nrow(refit_coefficients) > 0) {

}

if (nrow(refit_ph_results) > 0) {

}

if (nrow(failed_models_elastic) > 0) {
```
