```{r cox-elastic-analysis, results='asis'}
    failed_models_elastic,
    "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Failed_Models.xlsx"
  )
}

saveRDS(
  cv_fold_storage,
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Shared_CV_Folds.rds"
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    elastic = elastic_prediction_storage,
    refit = refit_prediction_storage
  ),
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/Cox_Test_Predictions.rds"
)


############################################################
################ Display warnings ##########################
############################################################

warnings <- unique(warnings)

if (length(warnings) > 0) {

  cat(
    '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
    length(warnings),
    ' unique warning(s) encountered during the analysis',
    '</strong></summary>'
  )

  cat('<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">')

  for (warn in warnings) {

    cat(
      "<p>",
      escape_html(warn),
      "</p>"
    )
  }

  cat("</div></details><br>")

} else {

  cat(
    "No warnings were encountered during the analysis.<br>"
  )
}


if (nrow(failed_models_elastic) > 0) {

  cat(
    '<details><summary><strong>',
    nrow(failed_models_elastic),
    ' failed fits</strong></summary>'
  )

  print(
    kable(
      failed_models_elastic,
      format = "html",
      row.names = FALSE,
      escape = TRUE
    )
  )

  cat("</details><br>")
}
```

## Obtaining the optimal lambda and C-index of each Cox model under different alpha values in elastic net

The machine-learning comparison uses the mandatory-only Ridge Cox baseline. The de-novo comparison uses the mandatory-only ordinary Cox baseline.

Ranges in parentheses are the 2.5th–97.5th percentiles across splits, not confidence intervals. Within-fit hazard-ratio confidence intervals are available in the detailed coefficient exports.

```{r cox-elastic-summary-tables, results='asis'}
############################################################
################ Elastic Net summary tables ################
############################################################

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)

output_directory <-
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary"

dir.create(
  output_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
################ Display helpers ###########################
############################################################

format_range <- function(center, lower, upper) {

  ifelse(
    is.finite(center) &
      is.finite(lower) &
      is.finite(upper),

    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      center,
      lower,
      upper
    ),

    "—"
  )
}


format_mean_sd <- function(center, spread, digits = 3) {

  pattern <- paste0(
    "%.",
    digits,
    "f ± %.",
    digits,
    "f"
  )

  ifelse(
    is.finite(center) &
      is.finite(spread),

    sprintf(
      pattern,
      center,
      spread
    ),

    "—"
  )
}


print_cox_table <- function(table, caption) {

  kable(
    table,
    format = "html",
    digits = 3,
    caption = caption,
    align = "c",
    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%

    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c(
        "striped",
        "hover",
        "condensed",
        "responsive"
      ),

      full_width = FALSE,

      position = "center"
    ) %>%

    row_spec(
      0,
      bold = TRUE,
      color = "white",
      background = "black"
    ) %>%

    print()
}


############################################################
################ Loop over responses #######################
############################################################

response_names <- unique(
  summary_results$Response
)

for (response_index in seq_along(response_names)) {

  response_col <- response_names[response_index]

  safe_response <- paste0(
    "Response_",
    response_index,
    "_",
    gsub(
      "[^[:alnum:]_-]",
      "_",
      response_col
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Response collapsible ####################
  ##########################################################

  cat(
    paste0(
      '<details><summary style="font-size:1.4em;"><strong>',
      'Cox Elastic Net Results for Response: ',
      escape_html(response_col),
      '</strong></summary>',
      '<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">'
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Loop over nfolds ########################
  ##########################################################

  response_folds <-
    summary_results %>%

    filter(
      Response == response_col
    ) %>%

    pull(nfolds) %>%

    unique() %>%

    sort()


  for (nfolds_val in response_folds) {

    cat(
      paste0(
        '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
        'Results for nfolds = ',
        nfolds_val,
        '</strong></summary>',
        '<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">'
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Summary table #########################
    ########################################################

    response_summary <-
      summary_results %>%

      filter(
        Response == response_col,
        nfolds == nfolds_val
      )


    summary_file <- file.path(
      output_directory,

      paste0(
        safe_response,
        "_nfolds_",
        nfolds_val,
        "_ElasticNet_summary.xlsx"
      )
    )

    write_xlsx(
      response_summary,
      summary_file
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        '<a href="',
        escape_html(summary_file),
        '" download>',
        'Download Elastic Net summary as Excel',
        '</a><br><br>'
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ########### HTML version of summary table ##############
    ########################################################

    response_summary_html <-
      response_summary %>%

      mutate(
        Cindex = format_range(
          Mean_Cindex,
          Lower95_Cindex,
          Upper95_Cindex
        ),

        Baseline_Cindex = format_range(
          Mean_Baseline_Cindex,
          Lower95_Baseline,
          Upper95_Baseline
        ),

        Delta_Cindex = format_range(
          Mean_Delta_Cindex,
          Lower95_Delta,
          Upper95_Delta
        ),

        Lambda_min = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Lambda_min,
          SD_Lambda_min
        ),

        Lambda_1se = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Lambda_1se,
          SD_Lambda_1se
        ),

        Selected_predictors = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Selected,
          SD_Selected,
          digits = 2
        ),

        Selected_biomarkers = format_mean_sd(
          Mean_Selected_biomarkers,
          SD_Selected_biomarkers,
          digits = 2
        )
      ) %>%

      select(
        Response,
        Alpha,
        nfolds,

        Successful_splits,

        Cindex,
        Baseline_Cindex,
        Delta_Cindex,

        Mean_CV_Cindex,

        Lambda_min,
        Lambda_1se,

        Selected_predictors,
        Selected_biomarkers
      )


    print_cox_table(
      response_summary_html,

      caption = paste(
        "Cox Elastic Net performance summary for",
        response_col,
        "(nfolds =",
        nfolds_val,
        ")"
      )
    )


    cat(
      paste0(
        "<p><small>",
        "Selected_predictors includes mandatory design columns ",
        "and selected biomarker columns. ",
        "Selected_biomarkers excludes mandatory predictors. ",
        "All reported models use λmin.",
        "</small></p>"
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ De novo summary #######################
    ########################################################

    if (nrow(refit_summary) > 0) {

      refit_table <-
        refit_summary %>%

        filter(
          Response == response_col,
          nfolds == nfolds_val
        )

    } else {

      refit_table <- tibble()
    }


    if (nrow(refit_table) == 0) {

      cat(
        "<p>No de-novo Cox results are available for this setting.</p>"
      )

    } else {

      refit_file <- file.path(
        output_directory,

        paste0(
          safe_response,
          "_nfolds_",
          nfolds_val,
          "_Refitted_model_summary.xlsx"
        )
      )

      write_xlsx(
        refit_table,
        refit_file
      )

      cat(
        paste0(
          '<br><a href="',
          escape_html(refit_file),
          '" download>',
          'Download Refitted Cox Model Summary as Excel',
          '</a><br><br>'
        )
      )


      refit_table_html <-
        refit_table %>%

        mutate(
          Baseline_Cindex = format_range(
            Mean_Baseline_Cindex,
            Lower95_Baseline,
            Upper95_Baseline
          ),

          Refit_Cindex = format_range(
            Mean_Refit_Cindex,
            Lower95_Refit,
            Upper95_Refit
          ),

          Delta_Cindex = format_range(
            Mean_Delta_Cindex,
            Lower95_Delta,
            Upper95_Delta
          ),

          Significant_ANOVA = ifelse(
            is.finite(Significant_ANOVA),

            sprintf(
              "%.1f%%",
              Significant_ANOVA
            ),

            "—"
          ),

          Selected_biomarkers = format_mean_sd(
            Mean_Selected,
            SD_Selected,
            digits = 2
          )
        ) %>%

        select(
          Response,
          Alpha,
          nfolds,

          Attempted_refits,
          Successful_refits,
          Failed_refits,

          Baseline_Cindex,
          Refit_Cindex,
          Delta_Cindex,

          Median_ANOVA,
          Significant_ANOVA,

          Median_PH_global_p,

          Selected_biomarkers
        )


      print_cox_table(
        refit_table_html,

        caption = paste(
          "Refitted Cox performance summary for",
          response_col,
          "(nfolds =",
          nfolds_val,
          ")"
        )
      )


      cat(
        paste0(
          "<p><small>",
          "Performance summaries use successful refits only. ",
          "Significant ANOVA is the percentage of all ",
          n_seeds,
          " requested splits with likelihood-ratio p &lt; 0.05. ",
          "Training AIC/BIC and event-to-coefficient information ",
          "are included in the Excel export.",
          "</small></p>"
        )
      )
    }


    ########################################################
    ############ Refitted coefficient summary ##############
    ########################################################

    if (nrow(refit_coefficients_summary) > 0) {

      coef_summary_raw <-
        refit_coefficients_summary %>%

        filter(
          Response == response_col,
          nfolds == nfolds_val
        )

    } else {

      coef_summary_raw <- tibble()
    }


    if (nrow(coef_summary_raw) == 0) {

      cat(
        "<p>No estimable refitted coefficient summaries are available.</p>"
      )

    } else {

      coef_summary_numeric <-
        coef_summary_raw %>%

        left_join(
          selection_frequency %>%

            rename(
              term = Variable
            ) %>%

            select(
              Response,
              Alpha,
              nfolds,
              term,
              Selection_frequency
            ),

          by = c(
            "Response",
            "Alpha",
            "nfolds",
            "term"
          )
        )


      coef_summary <-
        coef_summary_numeric %>%

        mutate(
          Beta = format_mean_sd(
            Mean_Beta,
            SD_Beta
          ),

          HR_display = format_range(
            Mean_HR,
            Lower95_HR,
            Upper95_HR
          )
        ) %>%

        rename(
          Predictor = term,

          `Selection (%)` = Selection_frequency,

          `Estimated splits` = Estimated_splits,

          `β ± SD` = Beta,

          `Hazard Ratio` = HR_display,

          `Mean SE` = Mean_SE,

          `Mean Wald z` = Mean_Wald_z,

          `Median p` = Median_p,

          `Mean FDR` = Mean_FDR
        ) %>%

        select(
          Response,
          Alpha,
          nfolds,
          Predictor,

          `Selection (%)`,
          `Estimated splits`,

          `β ± SD`,
          `Hazard Ratio`,

          `Mean SE`,
          `Mean Wald z`,

          `Median p`,
          `Mean FDR`
        ) %>%

        arrange(
          Alpha,
          desc(`Selection (%)`),
          Predictor
        )


      coef_file <- file.path(
        output_directory,

        paste0(
          safe_response,
          "_nfolds_",
          nfolds_val,
          "_Refitted_coefficients_summary.xlsx"
        )
      )


      write_xlsx(
        list(
          Numeric_summary = coef_summary_numeric,
          Display_summary = coef_summary
        ),

        path = coef_file
      )


      cat(
        paste0(
          '<br><a href="',
          escape_html(coef_file),
          '" download>',
          'Download Refitted Cox Coefficient Summary as Excel',
          '</a><br><br>'
        )
      )


      coef_summary_html <-
        coef_summary %>%

        mutate(
          `Median p` = format.pval(
            `Median p`,
            digits = 3,
            eps = 0.001
          ),

          `Mean FDR` = format.pval(
            `Mean FDR`,
            digits = 3,
            eps = 0.001
          )
        )


      print_cox_table(
        coef_summary_html,

        caption = paste(
          "Refitted Cox coefficient summary for",
          response_col,
          "(nfolds =",
          nfolds_val,
          ")"
        )
      )


      cat(
        paste0(
          "<p><small>",
          "Hazard Ratio shows the mean HR and its empirical ",
          "2.5th–97.5th percentile range across estimable refits. ",
          "It is not a pooled confidence interval. ",
          "Selection percentages use all ",
          n_seeds,
          " requested splits. ",
          "Refit p-values and FDR remain exploratory after ",
          "biomarker selection. ",
          "Mean FDR and median p-values are descriptive summaries.",
          "</small></p>"
        )
      )
    }


    ########################################################
    ################ Close nfolds panel ####################
    ########################################################

    cat("</div></details><br>")
  }


  ##########################################################
  ################ Close response panel ####################
  ##########################################################

  cat("</div></details><br>")
}
```



## Obtaining the coefficients selected by Elastic Net and displaying the de-novo Cox refits

The preceding section fitted an ordinary Cox proportional hazards model using the mandatory predictors plus biomarkers with nonzero Elastic Net coefficients. Each de-novo Cox model was compared with its mandatory-predictor-only Cox baseline using a partial-likelihood ratio test.

These refitted models differ from the penalized Cox models: their coefficients are estimated using ordinary Cox regression rather than Elastic Net. If no candidate biomarkers were selected, the refitted model equals the baseline model, their test C-indices are identical, and the nested-model comparison p-value is undefined.

The first table shows the penalized Cox coefficients for selected biomarkers and all mandatory predictors. Mandatory predictors remain displayed even if their estimated coefficients equal zero.

The second table shows the corresponding de-novo Cox coefficients, hazard ratios, confidence intervals, standard errors, Wald z statistics, p-values, and FDR-adjusted p-values. This inference is exploratory because biomarker selection and refitting used the same training observations.

For each alpha/fold configuration, the two successful splits whose refitted test C-indices are closest to the mean are displayed. They are descriptive illustrations, not independently selected final models.

```{r representative-cox-models, results='asis', fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
############################################################
############ Representative Elastic Net models #############
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(ggplot2)

representative_directory <- "Representative Elastic Net Models"

dir.create(
  representative_directory,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)


############################################################
################ Display helpers ###########################
############################################################

escape_html <- function(x) {
  as.character(
    htmltools::htmlEscape(as.character(x))
  )
}


print_representative_table <- function(table, caption) {

  kable(
    table,

    format = "html",

    digits = 3,

    caption = caption,

    align = "c",

    escape = TRUE
  ) %>%

    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c(
        "striped",
        "hover",
        "condensed",
        "responsive"
      ),

      full_width = FALSE,

      position = "center"
    ) %>%

    row_spec(
      0,
      bold = TRUE,
      color = "white",
      background = "black"
    ) %>%

    print()
}


plot_cox_cv <- function(cvfit) {

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)

  on.exit(
    par(old_par),
    add = TRUE
  )

  par(
    mar = c(5, 5, 5.5, 2),
    oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)
  )

  plot(cvfit)

  title(
    main = "Cox Elastic Net Cross-validation",
    cex.main = 1.0
  )
}


############################################################
############ Identify representative models ################
############################################################

representative_models <- tibble()

if (nrow(refit_results) > 0) {

  representative_models <-
    refit_results %>%

    filter(
      Status == "ok",
      is.finite(Refit_Cindex)
    ) %>%

    group_by(
      Response,
      Alpha,
      nfolds
    ) %>%

    mutate(
      Mean_Refit_Cindex = mean(
        Refit_Cindex
      ),

      Distance = abs(
        Refit_Cindex - Mean_Refit_Cindex
      )
    ) %>%

    arrange(
      Distance,
      Seed,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%

    slice_head(n = 2) %>%

    ungroup()
}


if (nrow(representative_models) == 0) {

  cat(
    paste0(
      "<p>No successful refitted Cox models with finite ",
      "test C-index are available for representative display.</p>"
    )
  )

} else {

  write_xlsx(
    representative_models,

    file.path(
      representative_directory,
      "Representative_Cox_Model_Selection.xlsx"
    )
  )
}


############################################################
################ Loop over responses #######################
############################################################

representative_responses <- if (
  nrow(representative_models) > 0
) {
  unique(representative_models$Response)
} else {
  character(0)
}


for (response_index in seq_along(representative_responses)) {

  response_col <- representative_responses[response_index]

  safe_response <- paste0(
    "Response_",
    response_index,
    "_",
    gsub(
      "[^[:alnum:]_-]",
      "_",
      response_col
    )
  )


  cat(
    paste0(
      '<details><summary style="font-size:1.4em;"><strong>',
      'Representative Cox models for Response: ',
      escape_html(response_col),
      '</strong></summary>',
      '<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">'
    )
  )


  ##########################################################
  ################ Loop over nfolds ########################
  ##########################################################

  response_folds <-
    representative_models %>%

    filter(
      Response == response_col
    ) %>%

    pull(nfolds) %>%

    unique() %>%

    sort()


  for (nfolds_val in response_folds) {

    cat(
      paste0(
        '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
        'nfolds = ',
        nfolds_val,
        '</strong></summary>',
        '<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">'
      )
    )


    ########################################################
    ################ Loop over alpha #######################
    ########################################################

    response_alphas <-
      representative_models %>%

      filter(
        Response == response_col,
        nfolds == nfolds_val
      ) %>%

      pull(Alpha) %>%

      unique() %>%

      sort()


    for (alpha_val in response_alphas) {

      cat(
        paste0(
          '<details><summary><strong>Alpha = ',
          alpha_val,
          '</strong></summary><br>'
        )
      )


      rep_models <-
        representative_models %>%

        filter(
          Response == response_col,
          nfolds == nfolds_val,
          Alpha == alpha_val
        )


      if (nrow(rep_models) == 0) {

        cat(
          "No representative models found.<br><br>"
        )

      } else {


        ####################################################
        ######## Loop over representative seeds ############
        ####################################################

        for (i in seq_len(nrow(rep_models))) {

          this_seed <- rep_models$Seed[i]


          cat(
            paste0(
              "<h4>Representative model ",
              i,
              " (Seed ",
              this_seed,
              ")</h4>"
            )
          )


          cat(
            paste0(

              "<b>Baseline Cox test C-index:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Baseline_Cindex[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Refitted Cox test C-index:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Refit_Cindex[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Mean refitted test C-index:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Mean_Refit_Cindex[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Distance from mean:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Distance[i],
                5
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>ΔC-index:</b> ",
              round(
                rep_models$Delta_Cindex[i],
                3
              ),
              "<br><br>",


              "<b>Likelihood-ratio ANOVA p-value:</b> ",
              format.pval(
                rep_models$ANOVA_p[i],
                digits = 3,
                eps = 0.001
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Global proportional-hazards test p-value:</b> ",
              format.pval(
                rep_models$PH_global_p[i],
                digits = 3,
                eps = 0.001
              ),
              "<br>",


              "<b>Number of selected biomarkers:</b> ",
              rep_models$Number_predictors[i],
              "<br>",


              "<b>Selected biomarkers:</b> ",
              if (
                is.na(rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i]) ||
                !nzchar(rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i])
              ) {

                "None; the refitted model equals the baseline model"

              } else {

                escape_html(
                  rep_models$Selected_biomarkers[i]
                )
              },
              "<br><br>"

            )
          )


          ##################################################
          ############ Cross-validation plot ###############
          ##################################################

          cv_key <- paste(
            response_col,
            alpha_val,
            nfolds_val,
            this_seed,
            sep = "_"
          )

          cvfit <- cv_models[[cv_key]]


          if (!is.null(cvfit)) {

            cat(
              paste0(
                "<b>λmin:</b> ",
                signif(
                  cvfit$lambda.min,
                  5
                ),
                "<br>",

                "<b>λ1se:</b> ",
                signif(
                  cvfit$lambda.1se,
                  5
                ),
                "<br><br>\n\n"
              )
            )


            plot_cox_cv(cvfit)


            cat(
              paste0(
                "\n\n<p><small>",
                "This plot shows internal training cross-validation ",
                "C-index. Higher values indicate better discrimination. ",
                "The fitted Elastic Net model uses λmin.",
                "</small></p>\n\n"
              )
            )

          } else {

            cat(
              "<b>Cross-validation plot not available.</b><br><br>"
            )
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Refitted C-index plot across splits ######
          ##################################################

          # C-index has no ordinary ROC curve.
          # Plot paired baseline/refit test C-indices across splits,
          # highlighting the representative split.

          plot_data <-
            refit_results %>%

            filter(
              Response == response_col,
              Alpha == alpha_val,
              nfolds == nfolds_val,
              Status == "ok",
              is.finite(Baseline_Cindex),
              is.finite(Refit_Cindex)
            )


          if (nrow(plot_data) > 0) {

            refit_cindex_plot <-
              ggplot(
                plot_data,
                aes(x = Seed)
              ) +

              geom_segment(
                aes(
                  xend = Seed,
                  y = Baseline_Cindex,
                  yend = Refit_Cindex
                ),

                color = "grey75",
                linewidth = 0.5
              ) +

              geom_point(
                aes(
                  y = Baseline_Cindex,
                  color = "Baseline Cox"
                ),

                shape = 1,
                size = 2.5
              ) +

              geom_point(
                aes(
                  y = Refit_Cindex,
                  color = "Refitted Cox"
                ),

                size = 2.5
              ) +

              geom_point(
                data = plot_data %>%
                  filter(Seed == this_seed),

                aes(y = Refit_Cindex),

                shape = 21,
                fill = "#B2182B",
                color = "black",
                size = 4,
                stroke = 0.7
              ) +

              geom_hline(
                yintercept =
                  rep_models$Mean_Refit_Cindex[i],

                linetype = "dashed",
                color = "#2166AC"
              ) +

              scale_color_manual(
                values = c(
                  "Baseline Cox" = "grey40",
                  "Refitted Cox" = "#2166AC"
                )
              ) +

              coord_cartesian(
                ylim = c(0, 1)
              ) +

              theme_minimal(
                base_size = 12
              ) +

              labs(
                title =
                  "Independent test C-index across splits",

                subtitle = paste0(
                  "Alpha = ",
                  alpha_val,
                  " | Folds = ",
                  nfolds_val,
                  " | Representative seed = ",
                  this_seed
                ),

                x = "Split seed",

                y = "Test C-index",

                color = "Model",

                caption = paste(
                  "Red point: representative refit.",
                  "Dashed line: mean refitted C-index."
                )
              )


            print(refit_cindex_plot)

            cat("\n\n")

          } else {

            cat(
              "<p>No finite C-index values are available for plotting.</p>"
            )
          }


          ##################################################
          ######## Elastic Net coefficient table ###########
          ##################################################

          elastic_table <-
            coefficients_df %>%

            filter(
              Seed == this_seed,
              Response == response_col,
              Alpha == alpha_val,
              nfolds == nfolds_val,

              # Preserve every mandatory predictor,
              # including any estimated coefficient equal to zero.
              Mandatory | Nonzero
            ) %>%

            mutate(
              Penalized_HR = exp(Coefficient)
            )


          elastic_file <- file.path(
            representative_directory,

            paste0(
              safe_response,
              "_nfolds_",
              nfolds_val,
              "_alpha_",
              alpha_val,
              "_seed_",
              this_seed,
              "_ElasticNet.xlsx"
            )
          )


          write_xlsx(
            elastic_table,
            elastic_file
          )


          cat(
            paste0(
              '<a href="',
              escape_html(elastic_file),
              '" download>',
              'Download Elastic Net coefficients (Seed ',
              this_seed,
              ')</a><br><br>'
            )
          )


          elastic_table_html <-
            elastic_table %>%

            select(
              Variable,
              Original_variable,
              Coefficient,
              Penalized_HR,
              Mandatory,
              Nonzero
            )


          print_representative_table(
            elastic_table_html,

            caption = paste(
              "Penalized Cox Elastic Net coefficients",
              "(Seed",
              this_seed,
              ")"
            )
          )


          cat(
            paste0(
              "<p><small>",
              "Penalized_HR = exp(Coefficient). ",
              "These are penalized estimates; conventional ",
              "coefficient p-values and confidence intervals ",
              "are not supplied for this Elastic Net table. ",
              "A Cox model has no intercept coefficient.",
              "</small></p>"
            )
          )


          ##################################################
          ######## Refitted Cox coefficient table ##########
          ##################################################

          refit_table <-
            refit_coefficients %>%

            filter(
              Seed == this_seed,
              Response == response_col,
              Alpha == alpha_val,
              nfolds == nfolds_val
            )


          refit_file <- file.path(
            representative_directory,

            paste0(
              safe_response,
              "_nfolds_",
              nfolds_val,
              "_alpha_",
              alpha_val,
              "_seed_",
              this_seed,
              "_Refitted.xlsx"
            )
          )


          if (nrow(refit_table) > 0) {

            # Preserve full numeric values in the Excel export.
            export_tables <- list(
              Coefficients = refit_table,

              Performance = as.data.frame(
                rep_models[i, , drop = FALSE]
              )
            )


            # Include term-specific and global PH diagnostics
            # when they were successfully calculated.
            if (
              exists("refit_ph_results") &&
              nrow(refit_ph_results) > 0
            ) {

              model_ph <-
                refit_ph_results %>%

                filter(
                  Seed == this_seed,
                  Response == response_col,
                  Alpha == alpha_val,
                  nfolds == nfolds_val
                )

              if (nrow(model_ph) > 0) {
                export_tables$PH_tests <- model_ph
              }
            }


            write_xlsx(
              export_tables,
              path = refit_file
            )


            cat(
              paste0(
                '<a href="',
                escape_html(refit_file),
                '" download>',
                'Download Refitted Cox Model Results (Seed ',
                this_seed,
                ')</a><br><br>'
              )
            )


            refit_table_html <-
              refit_table %>%

              transmute(
                Predictor = term,

                Beta = estimate,

                SE = std.error,

                `Wald z` = statistic,

                HR = HR,

                `HR lower 95% CI` = HR_lower95,

                `HR upper 95% CI` = HR_upper95,

                `p-value` = ifelse(
                  is.finite(p.value),

                  format.pval(
                    p.value,
                    digits = 3,
                    eps = 0.001
                  ),

                  "—"
                ),

                FDR = ifelse(
                  is.finite(FDR),

                  format.pval(
                    FDR,
                    digits = 3,
                    eps = 0.001
                  ),

                  "—"
                )
              )


            print_representative_table(
              refit_table_html,

              caption = paste(
                "Refitted Cox regression coefficients",
                "(Seed",
                this_seed,
                ")"
              )
            )


            cat(
              paste0(
                "<p><small>",
                "HR confidence intervals are the ordinary Wald ",
                "intervals from this training-set Cox fit. ",
                "They do not account for the preceding biomarker ",
                "selection or the selection of a representative split. ",
                "P-values and within-model FDR are therefore exploratory. ",
                "A nonsignificant PH test does not establish that ",
                "the proportional-hazards assumption holds.",
                "</small></p>"
              )
            )

          } else {

            cat(
              "<p>No refitted coefficient table is available.</p>"
            )
          }


          cat("<hr>")
        }
      }


      cat("</details><br>")
    }


    cat("</div></details><br>")
  }


  cat("</div></details><br>")
}


```
